Home / About TRIXX / Team

Team

Eight people who own the outcomes.

Design, construction, platforms, agronomy, valuation, finance and service. Every one of them has built something with their hands, and they still do.

Nadia Kombo

Founder and Chief Executive

Trained as a structural engineer and spent nine years in coastal construction before founding TRIXX in 2016. Nadia led the design of the Swahili Coastal range.

Design and strategy

Brian Wekesa

Chief Technology Officer

Built the TRIXX Home and Farm platforms. Previously ran IoT deployments for a regional utility, and holds the patents behind our soil-moisture controller.

Platforms and IoT

Zainab Ali

Head of Property

Runs listings, valuation and the verification team. Zainab has valued more than 3,000 residential properties across the coast and Nairobi.

Listings and valuation

Tom Gitau

Head of Construction

Manages the build programme across six sites. Tom introduced the service-spine standard that lets us retrofit technology without opening walls.

Build programme

Lucy Njeri

Head of Farm Solutions

An agronomist who designed the plot packages and the zone-planning method. Lucy runs the annual agronomy review visits.

Irrigation and agronomy

Peter Mwaura

Head of Finance

Structures the mortgage partnerships and owner subscription billing. Peter built the payment reconciliation behind TRIXX Rent.

Finance and billing

Aisha Mohamed

Head of Customer Experience

Owns the viewing calendar, the lead inbox and the 48-hour repair promise. Aisha has run the support desk since 2019.

Service and support

Kevin Odhiambo

Head of Security and Compliance

Handles device-data governance, camera policy and the audit programme. Kevin wrote our privacy position on camera and sensor data.

Compliance and privacy

How we are organised

Small teams, named owners.

Each site has a named project engineer and a named site foreman, and both numbers go to the client on day one. Support has a rota with names on it. If something goes wrong you know who to call, and so do we.

8 Leadership team
210 Staff across sites
6 Active build sites

Work with us

We hire engineers, surveyors, agronomists and support staff, and we promote from the site teams.
